summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a 67,000-metre diamond drill program at the Springer Tungsten Project in Nevada, along with re-logging of 18,000 metres of historical core. The program is an operational update on exploration and resource definition, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements. The announcement details drill plans, geophysical surveys, and a production target of Q4-2027, which is routine operational disclosure for a mining company.
